met.en: Yesterday I met my friend Tom in the park.
met.zh: 昨天我在公园里遇见了我的朋友汤姆。

above.en: The plane flew above the clouds and we saw sunshine.
above.zh: 飞机在云层上方飞行，我们看到了阳光。

ground.en: The ball fell to the ground after I threw it.
ground.zh: 我扔出球后，它掉到了地上。

those.en: Can you pass me those pencils on the desk?
those.zh: 你能把桌上的那些铅笔递给我吗？

ice cream.en: I want to eat an ice cream after lunch today.
ice cream.zh: 今天午饭后我想吃一个冰激凌。

us.en: Our teacher told us a funny story this morning.
us.zh: 今天早上老师给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。

finish.en: Please finish your homework before you watch TV.
finish.zh: 请你在看电视之前完成作业。

wait.en: Wait for me at the school gate after class.
wait.zh: 下课后在学校门口等我。

hurry.en: We must hurry to catch the early bus.
hurry.zh: 我们必须赶快去赶早班车。

hurry up.en: Hurry up, or we will be late for the movie.
hurry up.zh: 快点，不然我们看电影要迟到了。

dropped.en: She dropped her book on the floor by accident.
dropped.zh: 她不小心把书掉在了地上。

send.en: I will send you a postcard from my holiday.
send.zh: 我会从假期给你寄一张明信片。

email.en: I sent an email to my cousin last night.
email.zh: 我昨晚给我的表弟发了一封电子邮件。

ran.en: He ran to the bus stop this morning.
ran.zh: 他今天早上跑到了公交车站。

love.en: I love playing football with my friends.
love.zh: 我喜欢和朋友们一起踢足球。

list.en: Please write a list of things to buy.
list.zh: 请写一张要买的东西的清单。

er.en: Er, I forgot to bring my homework today.
er.zh: 呃，我今天忘记带作业了。

need.en: We need two eggs for the cake.
need.zh: 我们需要两个鸡蛋来做蛋糕。

first.en: First, wash your hands before lunch.

can.en: You can borrow my pencil if you need.
can.zh: 如果你需要，你可以借我的铅笔。

lost.en: She lost her key on the way home.
lost.zh: 她在回家的路上丢了钥匙。

how much.en: How much milk do we have left?

cheese.en: I put some cheese on my sandwich.
cheese.zh: 我在三明治上放了一些奶酪。

any.en: Do you have any apples in your bag?
any.zh: 你的包里有一些苹果吗？

use.en: I use a pen to write my homework every day.
use.zh: 我每天使用一支笔写作业。

over there.en: The schoolbag is over there, near the door.

bottle.en: I drink a bottle of water after playing football.
bottle.zh: 踢完足球后我喝了一瓶水。

half.en: We need half an hour to finish the game.
half.zh: 我们需要半小时完成游戏。

kilo.en: Mom bought a kilo of apples from the shop.
kilo.zh: 妈妈从商店买了一千克苹果。

a lot of.en: There are a lot of books on the desk.

weekend.en: I will visit my grandma this weekend.
weekend.zh: 这个周末我要去看望奶奶。

place.en: The park is a nice place to play with friends.
place.zh: 公园是和朋友们玩耍的好地方。

British.en: My teacher is British and speaks English well.
British.zh: 我的老师是英国人，英语说得很好。

museum.en: We saw many old things at the museum yesterday.
museum.zh: 昨天我们在博物馆看到了许多古老的东西。

how.en: How do you go to school every morning?
how.zh: 你每天早上怎样去上学？

best.en: This is the best cake I have ever eaten.
best.zh: 这是我吃过的最好的蛋糕。

took.en: I took the bus to school this morning.
took.zh: 今天早上我搭乘公交车去上学。

trip.en: We had a wonderful trip to the beach last weekend.
trip.zh: 上周末我们去海滩进行了一次美妙的旅行。

along.en: We walked along the river after dinner.
along.zh: 晚饭后我们沿着河边散步。

river.en: The river near my house is very clean.
river.zh: 我家附近的河非常干净。

hour.en: I did my homework for one hour after school.
hour.zh: 放学后我做了一小时的家庭作业。

twenty.en: There are twenty students in our class.

minute.en: Please wait for me for five minutes.

of.en: This is a photo of my family.
of.zh: 这是一张我家人的照片。

wall.en: The old wall in the park is very tall.

arrive.en: We will arrive at the zoo at ten o'clock.
arrive.zh: 我们将在十点钟到达动物园。

for.en: I bought some apples for my mother.
for.zh: 我给妈妈买了一些苹果。

mountain.en: We climbed a small mountain last Sunday.
mountain.zh: 上周日我们爬了一座小山。

with.en: I went to the zoo with my good friend Tom.
with.zh: 我和我的好朋友汤姆一起去了动物园。

plant.en: My mom bought a small green plant for our living room.
plant.zh: 我妈妈为我们的客厅买了一盆绿色小植物。

pair.en: I need a new pair of shoes for the sports day.
pair.zh: 我运动日需要一双新鞋。

shorts.en: In summer I like to wear shorts and a T-shirt.
shorts.zh: 夏天我喜欢穿短裤和T恤。

argue.en: We should not argue with each other in class.
argue.zh: 我们不应该在课堂上互相争吵。

matter.en: What is the matter with your little sister?

What’s the matter?.en: What's the matter? You look very sad today.
What’s the matter?.zh: 怎么啦？你今天看起来很难过。

wear.en: We must wear school uniforms on Monday morning.
wear.zh: 周一早上我们必须穿校服。

That’s OK..en: You forgot your book? That's OK, I have one.
That’s OK..zh: 你忘带书了？没关系，我有一本。

sports.en: My dad bought a new sports bag for me.
sports.zh: 我爸爸给我买了一个新的运动包。

hey.en: Hey, let's play football after school together.
hey.zh: 嘿，放学后我们一起踢足球吧。

nineteen.en: There are nineteen students in our class today.
nineteen.zh: 今天我们班有十九个学生。

crayon.en: I use a red crayon to draw a big apple.
crayon.zh: 我用一支红色蜡笔画一个大苹果。

fifteen.en: There are fifteen students in my class today.
fifteen.zh: 今天我的班上有十五个学生。

begin.en: We begin our English lesson at nine o'clock.
begin.zh: 我们九点钟开始上英语课。

give out.en: The teacher will give out the test papers now.
give out.zh: 老师现在要分发试卷了。

all right.en: All right, let's clean the classroom together.
all right.zh: 好吧，我们一起打扫教室。

thirteen.en: My brother is thirteen years old this year.

fourteen.en: I have fourteen books in my schoolbag.
fourteen.zh: 我的书包里有十四本书。

sixteen.en: She has sixteen crayons in her pencil box.
sixteen.zh: 她的铅笔盒里有十六支蜡笔。

seventeen.en: There are seventeen chairs in the classroom.

eighteen.en: I see eighteen birds in the tree outside.
eighteen.zh: 我看到外面树上有十八只鸟。

floor.en: Please pick up the paper on the floor.

forty.en: My father is forty years old now.

number.en: My lucky number is seven on the bus.
number.zh: 我在公交车上最喜欢的数字是七。

thirty.en: There are thirty students in my class.

fifty.en: My grandpa is fifty years old today.

sixty.en: The bus can carry sixty people at once.
sixty.zh: 这辆公交车一次能载六十人。

seventy.en: We need seventy chairs for the party.

eighty.en: The old tree is eighty years old now.
eighty.zh: 这棵老树现在八十岁了。

ninety.en: She got ninety points on the test.

happily.en: The children are playing happily in the park.
happily.zh: 孩子们在公园里愉快地玩耍。

many.en: How many apples are in the basket?

well.en: She can swim very well in the pool.
well.zh: 她在游泳池里游得很好。

team.en: Our team won the game yesterday.

really.en: The cake tastes really delicious today.
really.zh: 今天的蛋糕真的很美味。

good at.en: My sister is good at drawing beautiful pictures.
good at.zh: 我妹妹擅长画漂亮的画。

catch.en: I can catch the ball with one hand.

goalkeeper.en: The goalkeeper saved the goal in the last minute.
goalkeeper.zh: 守门员在最后一分钟救了一个球。

think.en: I think this book is very interesting.

fantastic.en: We had a fantastic time at the park.
fantastic.zh: 我们在公园里玩得非常开心。

fan.en: He is a big fan of basketball games.
fan.zh: 他是篮球比赛的超级粉丝。

past.en: It is half past seven in the morning now.

swam.en: She swam across the pool very quickly.
swam.zh: 她很快地游过了游泳池。

slow.en: The turtle is slow but it keeps moving.
slow.zh: 乌龟很慢，但它一直在前进。

healthy.en: Eating fruits and vegetables keeps you healthy.
healthy.zh: 吃水果和蔬菜让你保持健康。

a lot.en: I learned a lot from my science teacher.
a lot.zh: 我从科学老师那里学到了很多。

useful.en: A dictionary is very useful for learning English.
useful.zh: 字典对学英语非常有用。

show.en: I really want to watch a funny show tonight.
show.zh: 我今晚真的很想看一个有趣的节目。

presenter.en: The TV presenter is talking about a new show.
presenter.zh: 电视主持人正在谈论一个新节目。

blind.en: A blind man uses a stick to walk safely.
blind.zh: 一位失明的男士用拐杖安全行走。

deaf.en: The deaf girl can read your lips very well.
deaf.zh: 那个失聪的女孩能很好地读你的唇语。

hear.en: I can hear birds singing in the morning.
hear.zh: 早上我能听到鸟儿唱歌。

her.en: I gave her a book for her birthday.
her.zh: 我给了她一本书作为生日礼物。

fire.en: We called 119 when we saw the fire.
fire.zh: 我们看到火灾时拨打了119。

firefighter.en: A brave firefighter saved the cat from the tree.
firefighter.zh: 一位勇敢的消防员从树上救下了猫。

hot dog.en: I want a hot dog with ketchup for lunch.
hot dog.zh: 我午餐想要一个加番茄酱的热狗。

sausage.en: My dad cooks a sausage for breakfast every day.
sausage.zh: 我爸爸每天早餐都煮一根香肠。

kind.en: A kind boy helps his friend with homework.
kind.zh: 一个友好的男孩帮助他的朋友做作业。

time.en: What time do you go to school every day?

school.en: I walk to school with my friend every day.
school.zh: 我每天和朋友步行去上学。

start.en: Our English class will start at nine o'clock.
start.zh: 我们的英语课将在九点开始。

late.en: Don't be late for the morning meeting please.

go to bed.en: I go to bed at ten o'clock on school nights.
go to bed.zh: 上学晚上我十点上床睡觉。

exercise.en: My dad does exercise in the park every morning.
exercise.zh: 我爸爸每天早上在公园锻炼。

playground.en: We play football on the playground after lunch.
playground.zh: 午饭后我们在操场上踢足球。

before.en: Please finish your homework before dinner time.
before.zh: 请在晚饭前完成你的作业。

join.en: I want to join the school art club this year.
join.zh: 今年我想加入学校的美术俱乐部。

skipping rope.en: My little sister loves her new skipping rope very much.
skipping rope.zh: 我的小妹妹非常喜欢她的新跳绳。

coffee.en: My mom drinks coffee every morning to wake up.
coffee.zh: 我妈妈每天早上喝咖啡提神。

tea.en: Grandpa likes to drink hot tea after dinner.
tea.zh: 爷爷喜欢晚饭后喝热茶。

always.en: She always helps her mother clean the kitchen.
always.zh: 她总是帮妈妈打扫厨房。

bell.en: I heard the school bell ring at noon.
bell.zh: 我中午听到了学校的铃声。

rang.en: The doorbell rang when I was eating.
rang.zh: 我正在吃饭时门铃响了。

into.en: She walked into the kitchen for water.

feel.en: I feel happy when I play with my dog.

bored.en: He feels bored on rainy days at home.
bored.zh: 下雨天待在家里他感到无聊。

sad.en: She was sad because her cat ran away.
sad.zh: 她很难过因为她的猫跑掉了。

woof.en: My dog says woof when he sees me.
woof.zh: 我的狗看到我时叫汪汪。

miss.en: I miss my best friend during summer vacation.
miss.zh: 暑假期间我想念我最好的朋友。

angry.en: My dad gets angry when I don't clean up.
angry.zh: 我不收拾时爸爸会生气。

ill.en: She stayed home because she felt ill.
ill.zh: 她因为感觉不舒服而待在家里。

told.en: Mom told me to finish my homework first.
told.zh: 妈妈告诉我先完成作业。

better.en: After medicine, he felt much better today.
better.zh: 吃了药后，他今天感觉好多了。

farm.en: My uncle works on a big farm every day.
farm.zh: 我叔叔每天都在一个大农场工作。

tired.en: After running, I feel very tired and want to rest.
tired.zh: 跑步后，我感到很累，想休息一下。

won.en: She won first place in the school running race.
won.zh: 她在学校跑步比赛中赢得了第一名。

ruler.en: Please bring your ruler to the math class tomorrow.
ruler.zh: 明天请带你的直尺来上数学课。

smell.en: I can smell fresh bread from the bakery nearby.
smell.zh: 我能闻到附近面包店新鲜面包的味道。

kitchen.en: Mom is cooking delicious chicken soup in the kitchen.
kitchen.zh: 妈妈正在厨房里煮美味的鸡汤。

toilet.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet in this building?
toilet.zh: 请问，这座大楼里的卫生间在哪里？

room.en: My room is small but very clean and tidy.
room.zh: 我的房间虽小，但非常干净整洁。

living room.en: We watch TV together in the living room every evening.
living room.zh: 我们每天晚上一起在客厅看电视。

hide-and-seek.en: The children love to play hide-and-seek in the park.
hide-and-seek.zh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里玩捉迷藏。

now.en: Now, let's begin our English lesson together.
now.zh: 好，现在让我们一起开始英语课吧。

last.en: I visited my grandparents last weekend and had fun.
last.zh: 我上周末去看望了祖父母，玩得很开心。

hide.en: I like to hide behind the big tree in the park.
hide.zh: 我喜欢躲在公园的大树后面。

sofa.en: My cat always sleeps on the soft sofa in the living room.
sofa.zh: 我的猫总是睡在客厅的软沙发上。

shout.en: Please don't shout in the library; it's very quiet there.
shout.zh: 请不要在图书馆里大叫；那里非常安静。

grass.en: We can play soccer on the green grass in the schoolyard.
grass.zh: 我们可以在校园的绿草地上踢足球。

baby.en: The baby is crying because he wants his bottle of milk.
baby.zh: 婴儿在哭，因为他想要他的奶瓶。

dangerous.en: It is dangerous to run across the busy street alone.
dangerous.zh: 独自跑过繁忙的马路是危险的。
